mechanism_claims.claim_text: 2019-nCoV HR1 and HR2 regions interact to form a six-helical-bundle-like complex, supporting HR1 as a fusion-inhibitor target.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Mechanism is supported by peptide interaction/secondary-structure assays, not by an atomic structure in this paper.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: HR2-derived peptides are proposed to bind the 2019-nCoV HR1 trimer and block homologous 6-HB formation, thereby inhibiting membrane fusion and pseudovirus entry.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Figure 1k is a source model integrated with activity assays; it is not treated as independent structural proof.
